text:
Maya K: Heads up — batch invoice job for March ran with a hiccup, several accounts got preview-only line items promoted to final PDFs. Noticed on ACME and ZephyrCorp.
Rajesh P: ugh. any error logs? did the generator treat preview rows as committed?
Maya K: billing-bot posted a failure right after the renderer step. Quote: 'orphan_line_detected in invoice 0x9f8, aborting batch' but then renderer retried and created PDFs anyway.
Billing Bot: WARNING: invoice_generation: orphan_preview_line_detected invoice_id=0x9f8 user_id=acme_org action=render_attempt=2 status=partial_success
Leo: Can you paste the snippet? looking for the preview id field.
Maya K: here's the failing log block:
```
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z ERROR invoice_service: orphan_preview_line_detected invoice_id=0x9f8 preview_id=prv_7721 line_code=SUPPORT_ADJ amount_cents=2500
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z INFO invoice_service: aborting batch=mar-22 job_id=bg-991
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z INFO renderer: retry_attempt=1 invoice_id=0x9f8 status=rendered pdf_id=pdf_0x9f8_v1
```
Olivia (Finance): So the PDF has the support adj line showing as a charged line? That would make totals off by $25 for ACME.
Samir: ACME flagged a duplicate charge immediately. They DM'ed support. Ticket #FIN-4321.
Rajesh P: how many invoices affected?
Maya K: quick query shows 7 orgs in that batch with preview rows linked to the same preview_id pattern `prv_77*`. Most were skipped earlier but this invoice got promoted on retry.
Leo: Possible root: the preview -> commit transition race. The commit mark write happens concurrently; if job aborts after commit but before marking "finalized", renderer may double-toggle. We saw this pattern last Nov.
Olivia (Finance): We need fix + manual remediation. Options: re-issue corrected invoices & credit notes, or retract PDFs and regenerate. Which is faster? Customers already got PDFs.
Samir: For urgent ones (ACME, ZephyrCorp) propose credits + corrected invoice. For others, do a quiet regen and email-only updates.
Rajesh P: I'll take the remediation flow. Plan:
- disable auto-retry for renderer for this batch window
- run consistency check to list invoices where pdf_exists=true && commit_flag=false
- for each, if amount mismatch > $1, create credit note and corrected invoice, else silently regen
Rajesh P: tagging @Olivia (Finance) for sign-off on credits for ACME/ZephyrCorp.
Olivia (Finance): sign-off granted for ACME and ZephyrCorp credits up to $200 each. Please include note: "System-generated credit for invoice generation error."
Maya K: I'll add the consistency check SQL and run in staging now, then run on prod in 30m. SQL snippet:
```
SELECT i.id, i.pdf_id, i.total_cents, p.computed_total_cents, i.commit_flag
FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_previews p ON p.id = i.preview_id
WHERE i.batch = 'mar-22' AND i.pdf_id IS NOT NULL AND i.commit_flag = FALSE;
```
Leo: ping me if you need a hotfix. I'll also add a guard in renderer to assert commit_flag before finalizing PDF.
Billing Bot: ACTION: job bg-991 flagged for manual review by @Rajesh P
Samir: I'll draft the customer-facing note for ACME/ZephyrCorp once we have corrected invoice numbers.
Maya K: updating the ticket FIN-4321 with the plan. Will post results when the consistency check completes (ETA 20m). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Rajesh P: thanks team. keep replies concise — we need to minimize churn with support and finance while we fix this. :thumbsup:
